COORDINATES: measured on fpA, then moved by the rigid transform T (rotation +0.624 deg about (-8,8), shift (-0.119,-0.002)) fitted to fpB (4th floor): on fpB/fpC/fpD the central wing lies exactly at 32.3 deg, on fpA every M2 line drifts 0.5-0.9 deg (fpA is rotated ~0.6 deg locally; ER notes also report fpA distortion). Fit: 32 faces, rms 1.6 cm, max 4 cm (raw fpA: rms 14 cm, max 27 cm). So on a plain overlay2.py render of fpA this JSON sits up to ~0.3 m off the drawn lines in the south-west (mean 0.14, ~0.03 in the north); on fpB the parapets sit on the 4th-floor outer walls. 'python3 -I MR_build.py --raw' writes MR_rawfpA.json in plain fpA registration (overlays fpA exactly).

walls = parapets standing on the +11.85 slab ('base' 11.85, 'top', h = top-11.85). Parapet tops: +13.10 (plan marks on the west and south parapets; section ג-ג: 125 above +11.85 at the stair's east parapet) and +13.85 (plan marks on the east parapet and the bedroom block's east parapet; south elevation shows the step 13.10 -> 13.85). The change on the south parapet is the cross line at S u 5.815; on the NE it is assumed at the stair/east-parapet jog (no tick). Elevations only partly confirm this: the south elevation (secA) shows +13.10 / +13.85 / machine room +15.05 / +15.45 and a right-hand part at about +13.10; the east elevation (secB) writes +13.10 and +13.40. Plan marks used.

lower_walls / lower_railings = parapets and railings of the LOWER terraces visible on the roof plan, each with explicit 'base' (9.00 / 6.00 / 3.00): they belong to M4/M3/M2 floors ('also_in') and must not be placed at roof level.

Parapet thickness 0.20 everywhere on the main roof (double lines 0.20-0.21 apart); outer faces coincide with the 4th-floor outer walls of fpB within 2-4 cm after T. Chains on fpA agree with the measurement: west chain 82|248|490|475|260|203 = 1762 (measured 17.67), inner width 1051 (10.46), machine room 20|170|158|20 and 320 and 20|170, bedroom block 820 (8.18 outer).
Main roof polygon (centrelines) 130.98 m2, to outer faces 136.20 m2. Area tables: 4th floor built area 133.41 m2 (apt 6 117.12 + lobby/stair 16.20) + stair opening 3.20 -> ~136.6 m2 under this roof.

Machine room (item MR): outer footprint 11.08 m2 vs area table level +11.85 technical 10.96 m2 (7.36 + 2.52 + 0.79 + 0.29 = the same 4 rectangles). Top +15.45 (parapet), roof slab +15.05, base on the roof slab +11.85; raised machine floor +12.85 over the shaft.

Stairs: none on the roof (the M2 stair ends at the +9.00 landing); roof access through the hatch H1 above the stair's east end. Lifts: the shaft ends in the machine room (raised floor +12.85) - modelled only as the machine_room item, so stairs/lifts lists are empty.

Solar: 6 collectors (קולט) 1.51 x 1.25 in plan, in a row along the bedroom block (S frame), each with a boiler circle d 0.79 on its S-u+ side (towards the east parapet). Tilt/azimuth and heights are not drawn for M2; 40 deg with the high edge at the boiler side, collector top h 1.55 (~+13.40) and boiler h 1.98 (~+12.83..+13.83 on legs) are assumed equal to E's identical units (ER.json, section א-א).
